overview.description: The Toews Agility Shares Managed Risk ETF (MRSK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund shifts allocations between fixed income and equity securities, managing risks through option overlay strategies. MRSK was launched on Jun 25, 2020 and is issued by Toews.
